summary: Camtek Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a Notice of Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held July 29, 2026. The agenda includes re-election of seven directors, re-approval of indemnification letters to three directors, and re-appointment of KPMG as independent auditor. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or material corporate action. The filing is a routine proxy notice for an annual meeting in Israel, mapped to a US-equivalent proxy statement but without any transformative proposal. This is a standard governance filing, not a special situation.
